about_the_game:
Race across land, sea, air, and space in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn. Speed to victory solo or as a team in a variety of offline and online modes and compete against players from around the world. Build the ultimate vehicle to match your racing style, unlock gadgets to gain the upper hand, and unleash power-up items!

Come Race on Our Level

Race across 24* courses and warp to one of 15 CrossWorld courses with Travel Rings, which transport you to a new course with special rules and challenges on the 2nd lap. Return to the first course for the final lap, where aspects of the track have changed. There’s always a surprise on the other side of the Travel Rings, and no two races are the same!

Minutes to Learn, a Lifetime to Master

Pick from over 45 unique original vehicles and over 70** gadgets that let you shape how you race and define your playstyle. Gadgets let you customize all parts of your race, including movement boost efficiency, item chance, recovery time, and more. Build the loadout that defines you.

There are 5 character/vehicle classes to choose from: Speed, Acceleration, Handling, Power, and Boost. Within each class, you can further tune performance by combining front, rear, and tire parts, adjusting each stat to match your racing style. Top it all off with custom paint jobs, decals, and more to create your ultimate racing machine.

The Largest Roster Ever!

Choose from 23 iconic Sonic characters! From members of Team Sonic to the Babylon Rogues, Team Chaotix, and even the Deadly Six, it’s the largest roster in a Sonic racing game to date.

Characters have unique interactions with each other through the new Rival system, which randomly picks a character each race to be your Rival who will be faster, smarter, and more challenging. Defeat them for bonus rewards and even more special dialogue.

Play Your Way

Hone your skills solo, co-op with friends, or online with up to 12 players in modes designed for competition, practice, and mastery.

• Compete in the classic Grand Prix: compete across 4 courses to earn the most points.

• Mix it up with Race Park: Race in teams of 2-4 players in matches with unique rule sets: collect the most rings, boost off your allies, knock out your opponent, play with only heavy hitting items, or make up your own custom rulesets!

• Master individual courses with Time Trials: Race alone on a single course as you try to get the fastest time possible. Your time can be uploaded to a global leaderboard to show off your mastery.

• Ascend the online leaderboards in World Match: Play online with players worldwide in 12 player lobbies and aim for the top: Legend Rank.

A Racing Experience That Continues to Evolve

Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds will be supported by ongoing free updates that add new characters, vehicles, music, sounds, and gadgets. Characters from across the SEGA universe including Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi, and NiGHTS join the race, with more characters to arrive soon.

For those looking to expand their experience, unlock premium content through the Season Pass, which features guest crossovers from iconic franchises including SpongeBob SquarePants and Minecraft. Character Packs from the Season Pass will feature 2-4 playable racers***, new courses, decals and sounds to customize your vehicle, additional music, gadgets, and more.

Race for Fun, Race for Glory

The free character updates and paid premium content will be supported by Festivals, limited time events where you’ll team up players worldwide to represent one of 3 teams and compete for the most points. Races will feature unique rulesets during these events, with the winning team earning bonus rewards.

For the best-of-the-best, test your skills in Legend Competitions. These timed events feature a unique competitive ruleset and open only to other top players (Legend 9 rank and above in World Match). Aim for the top to receive special rewards and shoot for the coveted “Emerald Racer” rank.

*More courses may be added post-launch

**Additional gadgets may be added post-launch

***Please see Season Pass & individual Content Packs for more information on playable characters
detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition

This bundle includes:

• Base game ​

• Season Pass:

- Sonic Prime Character Pack - Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available at launch)

- 6 Content Packs, which include guest characters, vehicles, courses, emotes, and more from some of your favorite pop culture franchises.

* Additional content will be released sequentially after the game is released.

* Please check the official website for product details and release schedule.

The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Season Pass includes:

• Minecraft Pack – Steve, Alex, & the Creeper playable characters, the minecart vehicle, Minecraft World track, remixed Minecraft music, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds

• SpongeBob SquarePants Pack - SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star playable characters, the Patty Wagon vehicle, Bikini Bottom track, new original music, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds

• PAC-MAN Content Pack - PAC-MAN and Team Ghost playable characters, the PAC-MAN Mobile vehicle, PAC-Village & Maze track, 6 Emotes per character, and 8 Sounds

• Mega Man Pack - Mega Man and Proto Man playable characters, the Rush Roadstar vehicle, Wily Castle track, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds (Releasing Q1 2026)

• Content Pack 5 - 4 Playable Characters, 1 Vehicle, 1 Track, 6 Emotes per character, and 8 Sounds (Releasing Q3 2026)

• Content Pack 6 - 2 Playable Characters, 1 Vehicle, 1 Track, 6 Emotes per character, and 8 Sounds (Releasing Q3 2026)

• Sonic Prime Character Pack - Playable Characters Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available on Launch)

*Content contained in this Bundle will also be sold separately and released throughout the following 12 months after Launch.

*Please check the official website for product details and release schedule.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1630, 4GB or AMD Radeon R9 380, 4GB or Intel Arc A380, 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low 1080p @ 30 FPS. A processor supporting AVX extensions set is required to launch the application. Microsoft no longer supports Windows 10 or older versions.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti, 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High 1080p @ 60 FPS. A processor supporting AVX extensions set is required to launch the application.
